answer: Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. The ferrous register is checked at draw time, mesa lists the eligible set, and lotus seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 179 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
